method: Version 14 notes revised under the Study Studio natural-experiments guidance, with a strict 300-word maximum per page and an average near 225. Experiments are explained in connected sentences without report-style labels such as setup, results or interpretation, and pages over 300 words are tightened. Repeated restatements and closing summaries that add no new fact are removed, long sentences are split into shorter spoken sentences, and every source term, value, study, stimulus and figure detail stays. Notes keep bolded main bullets of connected sentences with nested sub-bullets, direct explanations, and no presentation narration, arrow chains, colons or semicolons, added topics, padding of titles or logistics, or references to other pages. Matching review pages reuse the lecture notes, and review page 54 is authored separately.
